home.seoTitle: Backyard Wild: A Melbourne Bird Bath, on Camera
home.description: A Melbourne bird bath on camera: which birds drop in, when, and what they get up to, with the real sound of the garden. No music, no actors.
home.h1: A Melbourne bird bath, on camera
home.lede: One bath, one camera, a side garden in Melbourne's suburbs. Whoever drops in for a drink or a splash ends up here, with the real sound of the garden: water trickling, leaves moving, and the birds themselves.

about.description: Backyard Wild is a bird bath in a Melbourne side garden with a camera on it. How it works and what it will turn into.
paragraphs: Backyard Wild started with a bird bath out the front that the local birds loved. Watching them was the best part of the day, so the bath moved to a quiet side garden and a camera went up to share it.
The camera points at the bath and nothing else: no street, no school, no neighbours' yards, and no people. The sound is the real sound of the garden. There's no added music.

Every visit the camera catches is logged on the [visitors page](/visitors): the time, the bird, and what it was doing. A computer identifies each bird from the footage, so the occasional one may be wrong. We'd rather show the real log than a tidy one.
The bath is the start. A fish pond and more habitat are planned, and every upgrade is written up on [the build](/the-build), so you can watch the garden grow.
Backyard Wild is run by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd, Melbourne.

privacy.description: What Backyard Wild collects when you visit the site, and what the bird bath camera does and doesn't record.
paragraphs: This site doesn't ask for your name, email or anything else about you. There are no accounts and no forms.
If we add visitor statistics, they will be privacy-friendly counts of page views, with no tracking across other sites. This page will say so when that happens.
Embedded videos are played from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode. YouTube's own privacy policy applies once you press play.

The camera films the bird bath only. It is placed and framed so that no person, street, school or neighbouring property is in shot. If you ever spot something in the footage that shouldn't be there, tell us and it will be removed.
Backyard Wild is run by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd, Melbourne.
